items.text: **Bot status line:** Bertha's Discord status shows a game in progress, the Daily Trivia countdown, or rotating Season, Double XP and Kirkening lines.
**Replay bonus:** +5% level XP for each back-to-back game, up to +25%, shown on the XP card. The next game has to start within 10 minutes, and both games need 10+ questions.
**61 new logos:** 39 brands and 22 NBA teams, none with the name in the logo.
**Geography Fun Facts:** all 358 Geography questions now have one.
**New category, K-Pop:** 100 questions on K-pop from 2016 onward.
**🔁 Last time:** opening the category box on `/trivia start`, `/quickfire` or `/hardcore` suggests the categories you picked last game first.
`/kirkening` is now listed in `/help`.
**Streak XP has no cap:** +2% per streak answer, with no ceiling.
**Fun Fact hints show ~70% of the time** instead of every round. Conundrums always show theirs, and duels use the same 70%.
**Duel rounds are 30 seconds:** 15s to the hint, then 15s more (was 10 + 10).
**A game that ends from inactivity now pays out XP**, the same as `/trivia stop`.
An expired duel challenge says "expired" instead of "declined".
The Level 100 progress bar says "to MAX" instead of "to Level 101".
When a flaming pumpkin pushes you into a new pass tier, its card shows the pass XP gained and a progress bar.
35 Geography questions were reworded after review, and one answer changed to Egypt.
A restart during Daily Trivia will no longer kills that day's game; it resumes. A Daily Trivia missed while the bot was down starts as soon as it's back.
Daily Trivia can't start on top of a duel.
A failed "correct answer" post could freeze the game.
An insane round could finish twice, and the end of a game could pay out twice.
Level-ups could show twice, or not at all, fixed
The 4-point window now starts when the question actually posts.
No stray question appears after `/trivia stop`, and stopping no longer erases the last round's winner from replays.
A game cut off by a restart in its last round now pays out.
`/trivia test` no longer affects the real channel streak, any test streak has been removed from history
Insane-round achievements are also checked when an insane round times out, not at the moment of a guess to prevent lag.
A failed game start no longer leaves the channel stuck on "a game is already running".
Two games or duels can't start in the same channel at once.
Resumed hardcore games use the right time limit.
Decimal duel answers get a proper hint (13.8 no longer shows as 13).
A failed duel result card no longer skips the payouts.
`/duel stop` after the result is decided says "already over".
Weekly Challenge rewards are retried until they're actually paid to prevent not being paid out during lag.
The Monday recap ignores `/trivia test` rounds.
Leaderboard ties are listed in the same order every time.
`/boost` fixes: a double-click on activate is handled properly, and a boost always runs for the length it had when you earned it.
The spotlight rollover no longer brings back last season's picks.
Scheduled posts keep running after an error: Double XP, Kirkening, the recap, Daily Trivia and the website export.
`/fixed` rejects unknown finding IDs.
Every level and pass XP grant is logged with its source, and older XP was backfilled. Pumpkins, streak breaks and hint timing are now tracked too.
Added users who haven’t played trivia before to the stats page regardless of no history.
each deploy will check that the running bot has the newest code, and check every question source against the live questions.
**🎃 Season 0 begins!**
A 15-tier season pass. Earn pass XP just by playing, and unlock rewards as you climb. See it with `/pass` and `/season`.
**3 Seasonal Spotlight categories** are revealed at 9 AM EST and are worth **1.5x points** all season (marked ⭐ in `/categories`).
**Prizes** for the top 3 in season points (50k / 25k / 10k XP) and the top 3 in Duel ELO (20k / 10k / 5k XP).
**🔱 Duel ELO:** every duel now moves your seasonal rating. You need 3 duels to be ranked. Everyone starts at 1000, and resets every season.
**📋 Weekly Challenges**
5 new challenges every Monday at 10 AM EST, the same 5 for everyone: 2 easy, 2 medium and 1 hard.
Rewards of **✦ 5k / 10k / 20k XP**, plus bonus season pass XP.
Check your progress with `/challenges`. The Monday Recap lists each week's new set.
Beware through the month, as there will be plenty of tricks and treats alike 👀

**First to 3 / 5 / 7 / 10:** a new style with no question limit, where the first to N correct answers wins. If both players go silent for 5 questions, it ends in a **tie**. `/duelstats` now shows W-L-T.
**Category bans:** after accepting a duel, each player can ban categories by typing them in chat (short names like `got`, `hotd` and `wtp` work), taking turns. Longer duels get more bans.
Pokémon + Who's That Pokémon count as one ban, and so do Game of Thrones + House of the Dragon + A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms.
**Rematch** lets you keep, redo or skip your last bans.
**Who's That Pokémon is back in duels.**
**`/duel stop`:** stopping your own duel is a forfeit, and challengers can **Cancel** a challenge that hasn't been answered.
Duels now end as soon as the winner can't be caught
**New category: Phobias 😱** (173 questions, every one with a Fun Fact).
**New hint: fill in the blanks** (`K#l## M##o###`). It only ever appears as the Second Hint.
400+ duplicate questions removed, and a batch of question fixes. Redundancy issues are still being worked out, thank you for your reports and kind words of encouragement.
**🔁 Play Again** button after `/trivia start`, `/quickfire` and `/hardcore` games. Your picked categories remain the same.
**`/boost`** can now **pause** and **unpause** your XP Boost. The XP card also tells you when a boost runs out.
**Level-ups and pass tiers** now show inside the XP card instead of spamming the channel.
**`/categories`:** a cleaner A–Z list, with disabled categories crossed out and ⭐ Spotlights marked.
**`user:` option** on `/rank`, `/achievements` and `/pass`, so you can look at other people's.
**`/equip`** only suggests cosmetics you've actually unlocked.
